case.story_summary: A single demonstration entry that links the GECKO oxygen-condition model comparison with the transcriptional-trigger paper reproduction workbench. Model Compare uses the GECKO run; Analysis and Summary use the trigger-paper run.
case.story_summary_zh: 一个统一展示入口：Model Compare 使用 GECKO 氧条件对比 run，Analysis 与 Summary 使用转录触发器论文复现 run。
case.default_query: Shewanella GECKO oxygen transcriptional triggers GDM D2T2 glycogen
display_caveats: This is a composite display case; it links two existing run packages instead of merging their files.
GECKO Compare evidence and trigger-paper Analysis evidence must remain stage-specific.
Fresh D2T2 recomputation, fresh dFBA solver runs, and fabricated enzyme capacity are out of scope.
display_next_actions: Use Model Compare for GECKO oxygen-condition evidence and kcat/proteomics overlays.
Use Analysis and Summary for Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, D2T2 reported triggers, and dFBA/glycogen paper-reported curves.

display_caveats: GECKO enzyme pseudo reactions are interpreted as constraint evidence, not conventional GEM structural diff.
Reaction-level capacity is displayed only when an existing capacity table is available.
display_next_actions: Open Model Compare and inspect TCA, glycolysis, and PPP KEGG-derived submaps.
Keep enzyme capacity marked unavailable unless reaction-level capacity output is present.

case.title: Shewanella transcriptional triggers in LAC/LB growth
case.title_zh: Shewanella LAC/LB 生长动态转录触发因子论文复现
case.story_title: Guarded evidence-chain reproduction of transcriptional triggers
case.story_title_zh: 转录触发因子证据链复现案例
case.story_summary: Uses Supplement and GEO processed data to show Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, paper-reported D2T2 triggers, and paper-reported dFBA/glycogen scenarios. Model Compare only overlays paper evidence that maps through GEM GPRs; nitrogen/glycogen regulators that do not map to reaction-level GPRs remain pathway-level caveats.
case.story_summary_zh: 基于论文 Supplement 和 GEO processed matrix 展示 Growth State Map、Trigger Timeline、GDM-lite、论文报道的 D2T2 trigger 与 dFBA/glycogen scenario。Model Compare 只叠加可通过 GPR 真实映射到反应的 paper evidence；氮/糖原主线中未映射的调控基因保留为 pathway-level caveat。
case.default_query: Shewanella transcriptional triggers LAC LB nitrogen glycogen GDM D2T2
display_caveats: GDM is a lightweight reproduction from processed expression and growth data, not the full original implementation.
D2T2 triggers and dFBA/glycogen curves are paper-reported tables; no full influence-network or solver recomputation is claimed.
Condition bounds, structural model edits, and enzyme capacity are not generated for this transcriptomics/metabolite paper.
Nitrogen/glycogen trigger genes are retained as paper evidence, but current iLJ1162 GPR mapping does not provide reaction-level overlay for that group.
Paper evidence reaction mapping is partial: 3 mapped genes, 14 unmapped genes.
display_next_actions: Use Analysis to inspect Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, D2T2, and dFBA/glycogen panels.
Use the default nitrogen/glycogen group for the paper story; switch to gluconeogenesis to inspect evidence reactions that map through iLJ1162 GPRs.
Keep bounds, fresh dFBA, and enzyme capacity marked unavailable unless curated parameters or external outputs are added.
